title: David Becomes King

questions.question: Where did all Israel gather to David to make him king?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:1 (ESV): "Then all Israel gathered together to David at Hebron..."

questions.question: Who said to David, "You shall be shepherd of my people Israel"?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:2 (ESV): "...and the LORD your God said to you, 'You shall be shepherd of my people Israel...'"

questions.question: Who was the first to strike the Jebusites and became chief?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:6 (ESV): "And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, so he became chief."

questions.question: What was the city of Jerusalem called before David took it?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:4 (ESV): "And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, that is, Jebus..."

questions.question: Who was Jashobeam?
options: The chief of the three mighty men
questions.correctAnswer: The chief of the three mighty men
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:11 (ESV): "Jashobeam, a Hachmonite, was chief of the three."

questions.question: What did the three mighty men do throughout the host of the Philistines?
options: They broke through and drew water from the well of Bethlehem
questions.correctAnswer: They broke through and drew water from the well of Bethlehem
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:18 (ESV): "Then the three broke through the camp of the Philistines and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem..."

questions.question: Did David drink the water brought by the three mighty men?
options: No, he poured it out to the LORD
He washed his hands with it
questions.correctAnswer: No, he poured it out to the LORD
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:18 (ESV): "But David would not drink it. He poured it out to the LORD."

questions.question: Who killed an Egyptian who was five cubits tall?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:23 (ESV): "And he struck down an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits tall... Benaiah went down to him with a staff..."

questions.question: Who was chief of the thirty?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:20 (ESV): "Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the thirty."

questions.question: Who stood in the middle of a plot of barley and defended it?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:12-14 (ESV): "Next to him among the three mighty men was Eleazar the son of Dodo... He took his stand in the midst of the plot and defended it..."

questions.question: Who was Uriah?
options: The Hittite, one of the mighty men
questions.correctAnswer: The Hittite, one of the mighty men
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:41 (ESV): "Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai..." listed among the mighty men.

questions.question: Who was the brother of Nathan?
Where did Benaiah strike down a lion?
options: In a pit on a day when snow had fallen
questions.correctAnswer: In a pit on a day when snow had fallen
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:22 (ESV): "...and he went down and struck down a lion in a pit on a day when snow had fallen."

questions.question: What weapon did the Egyptian have?
options: A spear like a weaver's beam
questions.correctAnswer: A spear like a weaver's beam
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:23 (ESV): "...The Egyptian had in his hand a spear like a weaver's beam..."

questions.question: Who rebuilt the rest of the city (Jerusalem)?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 11:8 (ESV): "...and Joab repaired the rest of the city."

key_verse_text: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD of hosts was with him.
